title: A Clerk sign-in round-trip issues a Secure HttpOnly session cookie the middleware verifies
asA: operator signing in through the project's Clerk-hosted sign-in surface
iWant: a completed sign-in to leave my browser holding a Clerk-issued session cookie that the project's middleware verifies on the next request
soThat: the project reasons about my identity on every subsequent request without me presenting credentials again

acceptanceCriteria.description: After a successful sign-in against the project's Clerk development instance, the response carrying the sign-in completion sets a session cookie named `__session` with Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Lax attributes.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an operator who has completed sign-in on the project's Clerk-configured sign-in surface backed by a real Clerk development instance
acceptanceCriteria.when: the browser inspects the cookie jar for the project's top-level domain immediately after the sign-in redirect completes
acceptanceCriteria.then: a cookie named `__session` is present with `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, and `SameSite=Lax` flags set; no other cookie carries the session credential

acceptanceCriteria.description: A subsequent request carrying the `__session` cookie to a route wired through the project's middleware boundary is treated as authenticated and the request-object carries the resolved principal.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the `__session` cookie from AC-9101-1 and a project route wired through the middleware from TAC-1001
acceptanceCriteria.when: the request is dispatched to the route
acceptanceCriteria.then: the middleware attaches a `request.auth` object carrying `principalId`, `roles`, and `organisationIds`; the route handler observes `request.auth.principalId` as a non-empty string that matches the Clerk-issued user id for the signed-in operator

acceptanceCriteria.description: The middleware verifies the session cookie against Clerk's session-verification surface on every request; a tampered cookie is rejected without a cached hit.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a request whose `__session` cookie value has been altered by a single byte from the value in AC-9101-1
acceptanceCriteria.then: the middleware treats the request as unauthenticated; no `request.auth` object is attached; the verifier's audit log records one verification-failure event carrying the failure class and no cookie value
